lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ zhǎodào xīn gōngzuò le?
lines.english: Heard you found a new job?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Shì de, shàng gè xīngqí kāishǐ de.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 挺好的。工资比以前高，离家也近。
lines.pinyin: Tǐng hǎo de. Gōngzī bǐ yǐqián gāo, lí jiā yě jìn.
lines.english: Pretty good. Salary is higher than before, and it's closer to home.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 还是经理。但这家公司比较大。
lines.pinyin: Háishì jīnglǐ. Dàn zhè jiā gōngsī bǐjiào dà.
lines.english: Still a manager. But this company is bigger.

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 很好。大家都很热情，帮我适应新环境。
lines.pinyin: Hěn hǎo. Dàjiā dōu hěn rèqíng, bāng wǒ shìyìng xīn huánjìng.
lines.english: Very good. Everyone is enthusiastic, helping me adapt to the new environment.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 恭喜你！祝你在新工作顺利。
lines.pinyin: Gōngxǐ nǐ! Zhù nǐ zài xīn gōngzuò shùnlì.
lines.english: Congratulations! Wishing you success in the new job.
